<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="ניסן_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917870_theRebbe_730" batchId="meluket-_D7_A0_D7_99_D7_A1_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917870_theRebbe_730__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contains the opening header and date of the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">Erev Shabbat Kodesh Parshat Chayei Sarah,</t>
    <t s="2">26 Marcheshvan 5716*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the verse "Ashrei tevchar v'tekarev" is recited before circumcision, corresponding to four levels, and that circumcision draws down from above the chain of descent.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"Ashrei tevchar v'tekarev yishkon chatsereicha, nisbe'ah b'tuv beitecha, kedosh heichalecha"1,</t>
    <t s="1">Now, this verse is recited before the covenant of circumcision,</t>
    <t s="2">as it is brought in the Siddur, the order of circumcision.</t>
    <t s="3">And the source for this is what is stated in the Zohar2:</t>
    <t s="4">"The early pious ones... when they would bring their sons for this sacrifice, they would open and say, 'Ashrei tevchar v'tekarev yishkon chatsereicha...'"</t>
    <t s="5">[And although in the Zohar there it says "the early pious ones," etc.,</t>
    <t s="6">the Alter Rebbe wrote in his Siddur3</t>
    <t s="7">that this is a matter equal for every soul.]</t>
    <t s="8">And the explanation of the connection of this verse to the covenant of circumcision is,</t>
    <t s="9">that in this verse four matters are enumerated:</t>
    <t s="10">"Chatzereicha" (your courtyards) in the plural, two aspects of courtyard4,</t>
    <t s="11">"Beitecha" (your house), and "Heichalecha" (your palace).</t>
    <t s="12">And the order of the matters in the verse is from below upward.</t>
    <t s="13">As it is brought in the Zohar there,</t>
    <t s="14">"First 'chatzereicha,' then 'beitecha,' and then 'heichalecha,'</t>
    <t s="15">this one is more internal than that one, and this one is higher than that one."</t>
    <t s="16">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="17">that these four matters correspond to the four worlds of Atzilut, Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah (ABiYA)</t>
    <t s="18">(as will be explained below, section 6).</t>
    <t s="19">Therefore, this verse is recited before the circumcision,</t>
    <t s="20">for through circumcision there is a drawing down from above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="21">and in order for this drawing down to be, there must first be the completeness of the chain of descent</t>
    <t s="22">(the four worlds)</t>
    <t s="23">as will be explained below</t>
    <t s="24">(section 7).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the difference between a courtyard and a house, and between a covered and uncovered courtyard, in simple terms and in halachah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">2)</t>
    <t s="1">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="2">that the difference between a courtyard and a house</t>
    <t s="3">(in their simple sense)</t>
    <t s="4">is,</t>
    <t s="5">that a house is a person's dwelling, and in the courtyard are found the animals and birds,</t>
    <t s="6">as it is brought in the Mishnah5:</t>
    <t s="7">"If one would place an animal in the courtyard... and raise chickens"6.</t>
    <t s="8">And within the courtyard itself there are two types:</t>
    <t s="9">a covered courtyard and an uncovered courtyard.</t>
    <t s="10">For the difference between a covered courtyard and an uncovered courtyard is also in halachah:</t>
    <t s="11">An uncovered courtyard</t>
    <t s="12">(when it is more than two se'ah, by Torah law it is a private domain, but by rabbinic law it is a karmelit, because it resembles a public domain7),</t>
    <t s="13">and a covered courtyard is a private domain even by rabbinic law8.</t>
    <t s="14">And the difference between them simply,</t>
    <t s="15">is that the guarding of animals is also in an uncovered courtyard</t>
    <t s="16">[and it only requires that the courtyard be surrounded by partitions],</t>
    <t s="17">and the guarding of birds</t>
    <t s="18">(which can fly over the partitions)</t>
    <t s="19">is specifically in a covered courtyard.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
